system.description:
Fight action: Nock and Draw: 7. Missiles: costs include enough missiles to outfit the character. Special arrowheads/bolt heads cost 1 rp per head type. Poor quality missiles cost half (rounded up) and are +1 Ob to hit; superior quality missiles cost 3x and grant a +1D balance die.

DoF modifiers: exceed obstacle +1, double obstacle +2, triple obstacle +3; extreme range -1 to the DoF.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 557
